children: Rheinmetall said it received a multimillion-euro order to supply artillery ammunition to an undisclosed international customer.

The German automotive and arms manufacturer said Monday that the customer ordered a low five-figure quantity of 155mm artillery projectiles. The contract value, in the low three-digit millions of euros, was booked in the third quarter.
The company has already started production and the order is set to be completed in 2027, it said.
